What you need
-------------

* AmigaOS 3.0 or newer on a 68020 or better; a 68040 is what the sound is made for (at a
  68030 the music may play with gaps: the sound task never takes more than its share of the
  CPU, it skips instead).
* An AGA or ECS screen in HiRes Laced (640x400, 16 colours), or a graphics card (Picasso96).
* About 1.5 MB of free memory, 250 KB of it chip RAM on a native screen; 4.5 MB more lets the
  program keep the whole pack in memory (PRELOAD), which is faster from slow disks.
* Sound through Paula (the default) or AHI (AUDIO=ahi).
* The game pack, adv98x.pak, built on a PC from your own copy of the PC-98 release (and, for
  English, the Fuzion translation) with the tools in Adv98X's source: `make data SRC=...` then
  `make pack` (docs/game-data.md in the source). Copy it into this drawer.

This build has not yet been run on a real machine or in an emulator; reports are welcome.
